title: Schedule of Cancellation Charges and Refund Timing (Window Replacement Contracts)
content:
# Schedule of Cancellation Charges and Refund Timing

Window Replacement Contracts contract schedule. Each Ridgeline series sets the cooling-off period for in-home sales, the cooling-off refund window, the cancellation charges by contract status, and the refund window and refund route for other refunds.

## Cooling-off and refund timing

| Series | Cooling-off period (business days after signing) | Cooling-off refund window (business days after notice received) | Other refunds issued within (business days after due) | Refund route |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 3 | 10 | 10 | to the original tender |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 3 | 10 | 10 | to the original tender |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 3 | 10 | 10 | to the original tender |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 3 | 10 | 10 | to the original tender |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 3 | 10 | 10 | to the original tender |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 3 | 10 | 10 | to the original tender |

## Cancellation charges outside the cooling-off right

| Series | Contract still signed (pre-measure cancellation fee) | Contract measured (measure-and-design charge) | Contract ordered (product share of the adjusted contract value) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | $150.00 | $295.00 | 55% |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | $150.00 | $295.00 | 55% |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | $175.00 | $345.00 | 58% |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | $195.00 | $395.00 | 60% |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | $195.00 | $425.00 | 62% |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | $225.00 | $495.00 | 68% |

## Reading the schedule

- The status columns name the contract status that sets the charge: signed, measured or ordered.
- The ordered figure is a share of the adjusted contract value, not a flat fee; the signed and measured figures are flat dollar amounts.
- The refund route "to the original tender" means a refund goes back to the card or account the payment came from, and a check is mailed for a cash or check payment.

## Hypothetical illustration

With a hypothetical product share of 50% (a figure no series uses) and a hypothetical adjusted contract value of $10,000, the share amount is $5,000 (50% of $10,000).
